frames.text: Google's AI can now use your Mac for you
It clicks, types and fills in forms across your apps and websites
You choose which apps it can touch. One click stops it.
It pauses for logins and payments, and asks before sensitive steps
Google's own warning: some actions can't be undone
For now: US, English, paid plans, Apple Silicon Macs
Follow @theunseencue for the AI stories nobody's covering yet
